data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘khaia’ meaning ‘to rejoice’. In the New Testament, the name Kaiya is not found but is similar to Kaia, which means ‘pure’ or ‘holy’ in the Greek language. The name Kaiya carries a sense of joy and purity, making it an excellent choice for a Christian girl. The name Kaiya carries the meaning “Pure, Rejoicing” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kaiya usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, rejoicing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
